top_signals.title: Thoma Bravo Sells Majority Stake in Command Alkon to Francisco Partners
top_signals.summary: Buyout firm Francisco Partners has agreed to acquire a majority stake in construction software maker Command Alkon Inc. from Thoma Bravo, underscoring investor interest in software crucial to specific industries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 53 cultural properties damaged by Kumamoto quake
top_signals.summary: The affected assets include three national treasures and 11 national important cultural properties.
